source_reviews.reason: Native 0x26945e5..0x26945f0 zero-extends the kill-code byte, subtracts one, compares unsigned against two and rejects above. Thus only kill codes 1..3 pass; zero must be rejected. The recovered signed arithmetic promoted uint8_t kill_code to int and accepted zero, compiled as only kill_code>3. Restore the explicit inclusive bury-through-sacrifice range before owner/test/callback/death-count processing.
